profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that trades under the ticker PONY. According to its own site, it is an autonomous driving technology company founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley. The company describes its core technology as a "virtual driver" and organizes its business into three units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). It states that it has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous driving vehicles in multiple locations worldwide, and that its vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024.

The site says Pony AI has accumulated millions of kilometers in autonomous road testing in complex scenarios, including difficult weather and road conditions, and presents this as groundwork for scalable autonomous driving products and services. It describes its aim as bringing safe, sustainable, and accessible mobility to the world and delivering autonomous driving solutions for everyday travel and commercial logistics.

The company's held record lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its SEC filing record shows CIK 0001969302.
